## Current Code Workflow (from code analyzer)
# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probes target masked BERT4Rec through a ModelView wrapper; backbone implementation is not supplied. Relevant hooks are `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)`, and `predict_score(features, items)`. For user geometry, histories are truncated, left-padded, and appended with the reserved MASK token. The user representation is the feature at the maximum nonpadding index—the appended MASK position.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the actual network through `view.model`, plus training histories and metadata interfaces. It discovers `sample_batch` from the network’s defining module. The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` batches with matching B × L tensors. Probes validate IDs, shapes, and finite supervised margins, run feature extraction in evaluation mode, and restore the prior mode.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Directional alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings with seed 42, averages off-diagonal pairwise cosine similarity, and maps it to [0,1]. Higher values indicate stronger alignment; they do not establish collapse.
- **Representation geometry:** Samples up to 256 items and users. Reports raw mean norm, centered variance, centered singular values, and RankMe effective rank. Low variance or rank can suggest restricted representations; norms alone are not health judgments.
- **Positive–negative separation:** Across up to ten batches, scores supplied positive/negative pairs at valid positions. Reports mean margin, lower-tail p10, negative-win rate, and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower failure rates generally indicate clearer separation.
- **Coverage and allocation:** Counts valid targets, terminal targets, observed input types, and empty batches. Exact corruption-branch counts require matching sampler bookkeeping. Optional training allocation counters are read from the model.

# Perturbation & Tests

The probes do not independently shuffle, ablate, or corrupt histories. They inspect loader-supplied corruptions and construct appended-MASK inputs for geometry. These checks characterize training supervision and inference-style representations, rather than controlled sensitivity to perturbations.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

`run_full_diagnosis` returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, covering alignment, geometry, allocation, margins, and coverage breakdowns. Unavailable measurements use null; category lists remain empty because item categories are unavailable.

`diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` embeds measured values and definitions, requesting JSON with `status`, `core_findings`, `key_implications`, and `evidence`. No interpretation is executed here. ## Current Code Workflow (from code analyzer)
# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probes target masked BERT4Rec through a ModelView wrapper; backbone implementation is not supplied. Relevant hooks are `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)`, and `predict_score(features, items)`. For user geometry, histories are truncated, left-padded, and appended with the reserved MASK token. The user representation is the feature at the maximum nonpadding index—the appended MASK position.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the actual network through `view.model`, plus training histories and metadata interfaces. It discovers `sample_batch` from the network’s defining module. The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` batches with matching B × L tensors. Probes validate IDs, shapes, and finite supervised margins, run feature extraction in evaluation mode, and restore the prior mode.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Directional alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings with seed 42, averages off-diagonal pairwise cosine similarity, and maps it to [0,1]. Higher values indicate stronger alignment; they do not establish collapse.
- **Representation geometry:** Samples up to 256 items and users. Reports raw mean norm, centered variance, centered singular values, and RankMe effective rank. Low variance or rank can suggest restricted representations; norms alone are not health judgments.
- **Positive–negative separation:** Across up to ten batches, scores supplied positive/negative pairs at valid positions. Reports mean margin, lower-tail p10, negative-win rate, and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower failure rates generally indicate clearer separation.
- **Coverage and allocation:** Counts valid targets, terminal targets, observed input types, and empty batches. Exact corruption-branch counts require matching sampler bookkeeping. Optional training allocation counters are read from the model.

# Perturbation & Tests

The probes do not independently shuffle, ablate, or corrupt histories. They inspect loader-supplied corruptions and construct appended-MASK inputs for geometry. These checks characterize training supervision and inference-style representations, rather than controlled sensitivity to perturbations.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

`run_full_diagnosis` returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, covering alignment, geometry, allocation, margins, and coverage breakdowns. Unavailable measurements use null; category lists remain empty because item categories are unavailable.

`diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` embeds measured values and definitions, requesting JSON with `status`, `core_findings`, `key_implications`, and `evidence`. No interpretation is executed here. These probes do not measure host validation HR@10, recommendation diversity, causal behavior, or gradient contributions.
